bio.text: Vicente Gonzalez represents Texas's 34th District, which includes all of Cameron, Kenedy, Kleberg and Willacy counties and eastern Hidalgo County, and serves on the House Financial Services Committee.
He earned a bachelor's degree at Embry-Riddle University in 1992 and a law degree from Texas Wesleyan University School of Law in 1996.
Gonzalez opened his law practice in 1997 and lives in the Rio Grande Valley.
